I didn't touch config, so it looks unrelated to this fix, but I didn't run the test on a clean checkout to confirm it already failed before my change.

The fix itself is unchanged: `anthrouter/handlers.py` now keys the routed-tier cache by the requested model as well as the conversation. A tier learned from a sonnet request can no longer be replayed onto an opus request.
